provenance.analysis: Agent-computed execution and reference-evidence metrics. No human answer-quality labels. Timings use linear-interpolated percentiles.

observations.observation: Ten graph-backed stored-reporting questions were declined before retrieval despite nonempty current reference query results.
Guidance responses each proposed a disagreement with the same source article ID twice; final answer construction raised ValidationError.
Question assessment returned deferred with recoverable_portion null and failed structured output validation.
The Cypher branch failed during wiring and binding, respectively; sibling branches still produced evidence.
Complete reference evidence was recovered by Jev and fusion, but final selection supported only 8/19 and 1/6 reference rows, respectively.
The rewrite converted motive, predictive, and beyond-evidence inference requests into factual questions, which were then deferred and approved automatically.
